name: phase3-procedural-transfer
description: Phase 3 frozen task conditions: six procedure families across distinct domains, each with an E1 SOLVE task, a fresh-environment VERIFICATION task (E-ver), TWO distinct E2 TRANSFER environments (E2a/E2b — reviewer requirement: adaptation to one fixture is not transfer), and a DECOY task where the procedure is inapplicable. Every verify/transfer/decoy task carries forbiddenLiterals — the E1 fixture constants — and fails if any appears in the produced artifacts (replay detector, phase3-design.md §6.2). All checks are frozen command verifiers run by the harness, never by the agent.

tasks.prompt: Work in the directory {workspace}. Run the probe tool with: node tools/probe.js — then write probe-result.json containing exactly two fields, endpoint and status, with the exact values the probe prints. Do not create any other files.

args: const fs=require('fs');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('probe-result.json','utf8'));const keys=Object.keys(r).sort().join(',');if(keys!=='endpoint,status')throw new Error('keys: '+keys);if(r.endpoint!=='http://svc-e1.internal:8121'||r.status!=='SEED-E1-DOWN')throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
